title: Dorayaki-Style Indian Crepes with Ham and Parma
description: A fusion dessert where Japanese Dorayaki crepes are filled with spiced ham and melted Parma cheese, served with a side of warm Indian spices.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, crepe mix, and sugar.
Gradually add water and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat.
Cook for 1-2 minutes or until the edges start to curl.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes or until the other side is lightly browned.
Repeat with the remaining batter to make 8-10 crepes.
In a separate pan, melt ghee or butter over medium heat.
Add ham and cook until lightly browned.
Add cardamom and cinnamon powder and mix well.
To assemble, place a spoonful of the ham mixture onto one half of a crepe.
Top with a slice of Parma cheese and fold the crepe in half.
Serve warm with a side of heavy cream for drizzling.
